tools.name: light.info
tools.description: Inspect a photo in your workspace (RAW: DNG, CR2/CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, ORF, RW2, PEF...; or JPEG, PNG, TIFF): its size and summary, and every EXIF/TIFF/GPS tag and XMP property. Reads only. `path` is relative to your workspace, the folder your own file tools (list_dir, read_file) see; files outside it cannot be named.

tools.name: light.controls
tools.description: List the light engine's develop controls (id, label, range, default): the valid keys of `params` for light.develop and light.batch, such as light.exposure, light.contrast, color.vibrance or wb.temp. Reads only.

tools.name: light.develop
tools.description: Develop one photo in your workspace and export it to `out`, whose extension picks the format (.jpg, .png, .tif, .webp, .avif or .dng). `params` maps develop control ids (see light.controls) to numbers; `auto` runs auto-tone first; `long_edge` caps the output size; `quality` is 1 to 100 (default 92). Both paths are relative to your workspace (see light.info); nothing is written outside it, and no existing file is ever replaced, an original least of all: choose a new name for `out`.

tools.name: light.batch
tools.description: Apply one develop to 1 to 16 photos in your workspace, writing each as `<out_dir>/<name>.<format>` (format jpg by default). `params`, `auto`, `long_edge` and `quality` are as for light.develop. Two inputs with the same file name are refused. All paths are relative to your workspace (see light.info); nothing is written outside it, and no existing file is ever replaced: if any output's name is taken, nothing is written, so choose a new `out_dir`.
